parameters.name: DomainSwitch
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable domain-level statistics. Valid values:

- on: enables domain-level statistics.
- off: returns user-level data. User-level data is returned by default.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of stream pulling. Specify the time in UTC. The interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 30 days, and EndTime must be later than the current time.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of stream pulling. Specify the time in UTC. The interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 30 days.
